question: Which Indian state released a draft child protection policy on 1 April 2025 inviting public feedback on implementation across institutions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gujarat** released a draft child protection policy on **1 April 2025** to ensure the safety and well-being of children across the state.
 
• The policy aims to cover all institutions, including schools, childcare homes, and other child-centric facilities, ensuring a comprehensive framework for child protection.
 
• This draft policy focuses on addressing vulnerabilities faced by children, such as **child abuse, trafficking, exploitation, and neglect**.
 
• The Gujarat government invited **public feedback** on the draft to ensure inclusive participation and to tailor the policy in accordance with the needs of the community.
